title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code — /verify and /code-review are now invoke-only, plus a broad safety pass and live MCP connector data for published artifacts
bullets.summary: The freshest release (first seen Jul 19) stops Claude from auto-running the /verify and /code-review skills unless invoked directly, ships tighter permission checks and safer Bash/PowerShell handling with the EndConversation tool and progress heartbeats for long-running tasks, and adds live MCP connector data to published artifacts so an artifact can pull fresh connector data each time it is opened.
bullets.how: The invoke-only change touches how our scan agents run skills (confirmable first-hand this session), and live-connector artifacts fit The Construct dashboard surface directly: a published view should refresh from brand-insights/latest.json rather than freeze at publish time.

bullets.title: MCP spec 2026-07-28 is now 8 days out — final adds MCP Apps (server-rendered UIs) and a Tasks extension for long-running work on top of the stateless core
bullets.summary: Beyond the breaking stateless rewrite already flagged (initialize/initialized handshake and Mcp-Session-Id gone, Mcp-Method routing headers, ttlMs/cacheScope on list/read, OAuth/OpenID auth, -32002 to -32602), the final spec formally lands MCP Apps for server-rendered UI inside the client and a Tasks extension for long-running jobs.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 8 days from a breaking change; MCP Apps is a genuinely new capability (an agent-callable server can render its own UI) and the Tasks extension maps to our long-running scan jobs. Run the one /doctor pass that yields both the unused-server list and the Jul-28 migration inventory before the deadline.

bullets.title: arXiv — The Orchestration of Multi-Agent Systems: Architectures, Protocols, and Enterprise Adoption unifies MCP tool access with the Agent2Agent protocol
bullets.summary: Formalizes a single architectural frame where agents reach tools via MCP and coordinate with each other via A2A, with explicit delegation and policy-enforcement layers — the current live research vein alongside AdaptOrch, Uno-Orchestra, and DyTopo in the same cluster.
bullets.how: Vocabulary and a governance frame for the fleet: The Construct already routes skills per task via MCP, but A2A (agent-to-agent) is a protocol dimension we do not yet use and should watch as the installed-skills registry grows. Borrow against CLAUDE.md governance, do not install today.

praxis_lesson: Quiet primary-release window — no new frontier model in the last 24h (GPT-5.6, Sonnet 5, Grok 4.5, Kimi K3 all off-window), so the load-bearing item is a deadline, not a launch: the Jul-28 MCP breaking change is now 8 days out and the final spec adds MCP Apps + Tasks on top of the stateless rewrite. On a slow day the disciplined move is to spend it on the migration inventory you already owe, and to note that live MCP connector data for published artifacts is the exact mechanism that would keep the V4 dashboard fresh from latest.json instead of frozen at publish.
